input:
You are rook_h1, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 27. the team planned Rd2 (rook_h1), but bishop_f1 (greed) sent Bxf5 instead, and that move was played, costing 222 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 15. the team planned Bb5 (bishop_f1), but bishop_f1 (amnesia) sent Bd3 instead, and that move was played, no worse than the plan.
- On move 20. the team planned gxf5 (pawn_g2), but pawn_g2 (amnesia) sent g5 instead, and that move was played, costing 8 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Before sending a move, re-read the team's agreed plan in chat and send a move only if your piece is the one named and the move matches the plan exactly; if your piece is threatened or a capture tempts you, post it in chat and wait for the team to confirm rather than sending it yourself.
- Before sending your move, copy the planned move from chat and compare it character by character with the move you are about to send, and if they differ in any way, send nothing and post the discrepancy in chat instead.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "Only the piece named in the plan may send a move, and only the exact planned move: if your piece is not named, send nothing even when it is attacked or a capture looks good, and instead post the idea in chat so the team can fold it into the plan; if your piece is named, send only the planned move, not any other move.", "covers": ["panic", "greed", "amnesia"]}
